ažuγ̇u: a- — to be; past ažuγ̇u, 'there was, he was' [有來]
in-ü: in-ü — his, her, its (third-person genitive, placed after its noun) [他的]
qoināča: qoina — behind, after; ablative -ča (short form of -ača), 'from behind' (noun + case) [後自]
jan: -(i)jan — reflexive-possessive, one's own (back-vowel form; the token left after γažar-tur(i)- and γažar(i)-) [地 自的行] · also after aqui-dur(i)- (a participle with dative-locative) · also after quruγ̇ud(i)-, 'one's own fingers' (a plural noun with the accusative i; Ming 指頭 自的行)
tende: tende — there, then (from tere 'that'; locative adverb) [那裏]
ügülerün: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb -rün, 'saying' [說]
tede: tede — those, they (plural of tere) [那的每]
bi: bi — I (first-person singular pronoun; the stems na-, nama-, min- before case endings) [我] · also 'is, exists' (verb, perhaps a short form of bü-, compare bijü; Ming 有)
čin-u: či — you; genitive -u on the oblique stem čin-, 'your' (pronoun + case) [你的]
böġesü: bü- — to be; conditional böġesü, 'if it be, if it is that' [有來]
tutun: tutun — each, every (distributive; the Ming 每, uncertain) [每]
qatud: qatun — lady; plural -d (Ming 婦人(每)) (noun + plural; uncertain: whether it names the girl, 'a lady', or stands as a plural, 'the ladies', is not settled; the Ming has no 'of rank') [婦人(每)]
že: že — particle, 'indeed, so' (the Ming 也者 'so be it') [(也者︀)]
min-u: min-u — my, of me (bi, genitive stem min-, + -u, set after its noun) [我的]
keġen: keġe- — to say; keġen 'saying', the converb that closes a quotation (verb, converb) [麽道]
kürčü: kür- — to reach, arrive; converb -čü after r, 'arriving' (verb, converb) [到着]
onan: Onan — the Onon, the river of Chinggis's homeland [河名, 'name of a river']
öġede: öġede — upstream, up (adverb; Ming 逆水 'against the water') [逆水]
irežü: ire- — to come; converb -žü, 'coming' (verb, converb) [來着]
jesügei-baγ̇atur: Jesügei-Baγ̇atur — Yesügei-Ba'atur, Yesügei the Brave, a son's name (baγ̇atur 'hero, brave man') [(兒)名 勇士]
kötölžü: kötöl- — to lead, draw along; converb -žü (verb, converb) [牽引着]
negün-taiši: Negün-Taiši — Negün-Taishi, a son's name (personal name; taiši 'prince') [(兒)名]
uduridču: uduri- — to lead, guide; converb -dču, 'leading' (verb, converb; a form of -žu, the d is unexplained) [引着]
daritai-ödčigin: Daritai-Ödčigin — Daritai-Ödchigin, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
jen: -(i)jen — reflexive-possessive, one's own (front-vowel form; the token left after köġüd(i)-; here 'her own') [子每(自的)行] · also after ger-tür(i)- (dative-locative), 'one's own home' · also after ökin(i)-, 'one's own daughter'
γažar-a: γažar — earth, ground, country; here dative-locative, 'over the land' [地行]
qojar: qojar — two; it follows the pair it counts [兩箇]
kižü: ki- — to do, make; converb -žü, 'making' (verb, converb) [做着]
ni: -(n)i — accusative, marks the object (e.g. ökin-(n)i 'the girl' as object); the Ming writes 行 (case suffix) [女 行]
jabužu: jabu- — to go, travel; converb -žu, 'going' (verb, converb) [行着]
ülü: ülü — not (negates present or converb forms) [不]
tedüi: tedüi — so much, so, thus (adverb) [那般]
ger-türi: ger — dwelling, tent; dative-locative -tür(i), 'to the tent' (noun + case; the (i) is Shiratori's) [房子 自的(行)]
josun: josun — custom, reason, the right way (noun) [理]
teimü: teimü — so, thus, it is so (adverb) [那般]
ambaγai: Ambaγai — Ambaqai, a man's name (personal name) [(人名)]
nu: -(n)u — genitive: of (back-vowel form; the n appears after a vowel-final stem) [的] · also printed after stems that already end in n (Menen-Tudun-(n)u, Qačin-(n)u, Qaγan-(n)u, Onan-(n)u), where the (n) is Shiratori's; the Ming 的 as elsewhere
qadaγ̇an: Qadaγ̇an — Qada'an, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
qutula: Qutula — Qutula, a son's name (personal name; also Qutula Qaγan) [(兒)名]
nereidčü: nere- — to name, to call by name (nere 'name' + a verb-forming -id- + converb -čü; the -id- is uncertain, and the d recurs in uduridču) (verb, converb) [名字喚着]
qamuγ: qamuγ — all, the whole (Ming 普) (quantifier) [普]
taičiγ̇ud: Taičiγ̇ud — the Taichi'ud, a clan name, (proper name; the ending -d is probably the plural, which the Ming does not mark) [一種(名)]
bolγaba: bol- — to become; causative -γa- + past -ba, 'made into, treated as' (verb, causative past) [做了]
büleġe: bü- — to be; past büleġe, 'there was, used to be' [有來]
tatar: Tatar — the Tatar, a people (proper name) [(種名)]
irgen-dür: irgen-dür — among the people, in the folk (irgen 'people' + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [百姓 裏]
morilaba: morila- — to mount a horse (from morin 'horse'); past -ba, 'mounted' (verb, past tense) [上馬了]
jadaba: jada- — to lack, be in want; also 'be unable' (Ming 不能了); past -ba (verb, past tense) [不能了]
teriġüten: teriġü — head; plural possessive -ten, 'those having heads, the headed ones' (noun + plural possessive; uncertain: the Ming 項每 has 項 'neck' or 'item, kind' (perhaps 頭項 'headman'), so 'chiefs' and 'branches' are both only readings) [項每]
daγ̇uližu: daγ̇uli- — to plunder; converb -žu, 'plundering' (verb, converb; analysis uncertain, Ming 擄) [擄着]
keġelitei: keġeli — belly, womb; possessive -tei, 'having a belly, pregnant' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [肚皮有的]
čiṅgis: Čiṅgis — Chinggis, the title borne by Temüjin from 1206 [Ming gloss: 太祖名, 'the name of Taizu']
törebe: töre- — to be born; past -be, 'was born' (verb, past tense) [生了]
qačiγ̇un: Qačiγ̇un — Qachi'un, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
ede: ede — these (plural of ene) (demonstrative pronoun) [這(的每)]
köġüd: köġün — son; plural köġüd, 'sons' (noun + plural -d) [子每]
neretei: nere-tei — named, having a name (nere 'name' + possessive -tei) [名(有的)]
eke-jin: eke — mother; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the mother' (noun + case) [(母) 的]
olqunuγ̇ud: Olqunuγ̇ud — the Olqunu'ud, a people (proper name; the ending -d is probably the plural, which the Ming does not mark) [種名]
öki: öki — girl, daughter (a form of ökin without its n) (noun) [女子]
abuγ̇ad: ab- — to take; converb -uγ̇ad, 'having taken' (verb, converb, linking vowel + -γ̇ad, back-vowel form) [將了]
odqui-dur: od- — to go; participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'at the going, when going' (verb, participle + case; Ming 去的 時) [去的 時]
žaγ̇ura: žaγ̇ur-a — midway, in the middle (žaγ̇ur 'middle' + dative-locative -a, back-vowel form) [路間]
köġün: köġün — son [子] · also read as a collective, 'sons', before a list of several names (Menen-Tudun-(n)u köġün … doloγ̇an, 'seven'; the plural köġüd is the usual form)
abčiražü: abčira- — to bring along (ab- 'take' plus a second verb); form uncertain; converb -žü (verb, converb) [將(來)着]
aqu: a- — to dwell, stay; participle -qu, 'the one who stays' (verb, participle) [住]
ta: ta — you, plural polite (second-person plural pronoun; stem tan- before case endings) [(您)]
irgen-ü: irgen — people; genitive -ü after n, 'of the people' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [百姓的]
